column1: # held.tsv — THE VALUES HELD OUT OF THE TABLES, hand-written (SPEC.md §0, the maintainer's ruling on hex of 2026-10-18).

# are not fine, whole algorithms are not fine either"). A run held here is carried in its table as
# `HELD:sha1=<sha1>`, the SHA-1 of the manifest's literal (quotes included), so the gate can prove the value it stands
# for without the bytes. Judged from each row's notes and the original's generators, not by disassembly (R-001).
# Columns: manifest kind row key bytes sha1 reason derivation (how the rebuild obtains the bytes instead)
